policy_assessment.provenance: sprites-worker-review.md ties the remote grant service to exposing Aperture over HTTPS after rejecting per-Sprite Tailscale enrollment. No rationale for exactly 32 requests was found in the inspected notes or worker_grants.py.
policy_assessment.retain: Separate agent code from orchestration and publishing credentials; retain timeout and reliable VM teardown.
policy_assessment.reconsider: A remote SQLite grant service, exactly 32 requests, and a model restriction need not remain architectural prerequisites if VM-attached inference meets the operational need.
policy_assessment.possible_design: Keep the local sandbox/relay, point its trusted upstream at Exe, and scope integration access to each job VM. This can remove the remote inference dependency on heavypad without exposing orchestration credentials.

limits: Gardener's pinned Pi 0.84.4 and full Prefect execution were not exercised in this probe.
Detach was tested for a subsequent request, not interruption of an in-flight stream.
No per-VM budget, expiry, or model-enforcement equivalent was established.
The managed Anthropic calls consume Exe credits; exact billing delta was not measured.
OpenAI transport needs an explicit compatibility change before production migration.
